# Journal Articles

## 2026
::: {.publication-card}

### Reduced order modeling of air-cooled data center using data-driven proper orthogonal decomposition

**Authors:** Shailesh Kushwaha, Ankith Suresh, C. Balaji

**Journal:** *Applied Thermal Engineering*, 303 (2026), 132277

**Status:** Published

**DOI:** [10.1016/j.applthermaleng.2026.132277](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.applthermaleng.2026.132277)

**Highlights**

- Developed a data-driven POD-Random Forest reduced-order model for air-cooled data center thermal prediction.
- Evaluated POD-RF against POD-LSR and POD-MARS.
- Validated the models using 114 independent test cases.
- POD-RF achieved an MAE of 0.621 K, RMSE of 0.831 K, and \(R^2=0.958\).
- Reduced online prediction time from approximately 5 hours for CFD to less than 1 second per operating condition.

:::

## 2023
::: {.publication-card}

### Heat transfer performance of a novel PCM based heat sink coupled with heat pipe: An experimental study

**Authors:** Shailesh Kushwaha, Naresh Yarramsetty, Jyotirmay Banerjee

**Journal:** *Applied Thermal Engineering*, 229 (2023), 120552

**Status:** Published

**DOI:** [10.1016/j.applthermaleng.2023.120552](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.applthermaleng.2023.120552)

**Highlights**

- Conducted experimental investigations of PCM-based heat sinks.
- Investigated different fin configurations and PCM fill ratios.
- Developed a three-fin heat sink coupled with a heat pipe.
- The heat-pipe-coupled configuration improved charging and discharging performance compared with the three-fin heat sink.

:::
